record.dic_text:
05821 `Azzan {az-zawn'}

源自 05794; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Azzan 1; 1

阿散 = "非常強壯"
1) 以薩迦支派首領帕鐵的父親, 在分配應許之地的時候, 帕鐵代表其支派
   (#民 34:26|)
record.edic_text:
05821 `Azzan {az-zawn'}

from 05794;; n pr m

AV - Azzan 1; 1

Azzan = "very strong"
1) father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented
   his tribe in the division of the promised land
